latest_collective_demand_motivation.user_question: Can tens of millions choosing less demanding AI reduce aggregate electricity/environmental impact and slow performance escalation?
latest_collective_demand_motivation.grounded_answer: Lower-energy serving choices can reduce electricity; weaker capability or smaller parameter count alone does not guarantee savings. Aggregate effects depend on demand, retries and operations.
latest_collective_demand_motivation.broader_motivation: Potential moderation of collective resource-demand growth
latest_collective_demand_motivation.frontier_development_slowdown: Unverified market hypothesis, not established effect of Eco use
latest_collective_demand_motivation.example: 30 million people * 10 requests/day * assumed actual 0.1 Wh saving = 30 MWh/day; not measured or predicted
latest_collective_demand_motivation.high_capability_vs_efficiency: Not mutually exclusive; newer systems can improve both
latest_collective_demand_motivation.current_HCI_scope: User expectations, conditional trade-offs and scenario choices; does not establish system-level environmental or industrial effects.
